stops.title: Classification of polymers & LDPE/HDPE/Teflon/PAN
stops.inShort: On intermolecular forces: Elastomers, Fibres, Thermoplastics, Thermosetting polymers. Teflon monomer: tetrafluoroethene (CF₂=CF₂). PAN monomer: acrylonitrile (CH₂=CH-CN). LDPE is used in squeeze bottles, pipes, insulation.

stops.title: Natural rubber, Nylon-6, Nylon-6,6 & Biodegradable polymers
stops.inShort: Natural rubber monomer: isoprene (2-methyl-1,3-butadiene). Nylon-6 monomer: ε-caprolactam. Biodegradable polymers: PHBV, Nylon-2-nylon-6.

items.f: Natural rubber: isoprene;  Nylon-6: ε-caprolactam;  Teflon: CF₂=CF₂

board.text: Write the IUPAC name of isoprene.
Mention the types of polymers formed on the basis of intermolecular forces. Write any two uses of low density polyethylene.
board.answer:
Four types based on intermolecular forces: (1) Elastomers (2) Fibres (3) Thermoplastic polymers (4) Thermosetting polymers.
Uses of LDPE: (1) Manufacture of flexible pipes and squeeze bottles; (2) Insulation of electric cables / packaging films.

board.text: The monomer used in preparation of teflon is ____.
Write the structure and name of monomer of (a) Nylon-6 (b) Natural rubber.
board.answer:
(a) Nylon-6: ε-Caprolactam (7-membered cyclic amide: −NH−(CH₂)₅−CO−).
(b) Natural rubber: Isoprene / 2-methylbuta-1,3-diene, CH₂=C(CH₃)−CH=CH₂.
